subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose Slack and Discord workspace/server channel creation through the message tool and CLI, and what default-off gates, provider scopes, and requester authorization should be required?
rationale: The requested feature lets agents mutate provider-side workspace/server structure, and current main has no accepted Slack channel-management gate or cross-provider authorization boundary for this capability.

options.title: Approve default-off provider gates
options.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel-management gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

options.title: Narrow to Discord CLI first
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65065 as the only near-term work and leave Slack channel creation for a separate security/product decision.

options.title: Decline native channel creation
options.body: Keep workspace/server provisioning in provider-native admin tools or external scripts unless stronger product need appears.

recommendation.title: Approve default-off provider gates
recommendation.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel-management gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the prior detailed review and is the highest-confidence routing candidate from current CLI/message-surface history.
